observation_reviews.rationale: The fix is verified (see the income_identity entry), but the detection decision would not catch recurrence. income_identity (scripts/shadow_identity_engine.py) tests NII ~ TII - net_expenses (or total_expenses). Here it fired only because net_expenses was stored on the true-quarter basis while TII, total expenses and NII were stored halved. A fund that began mid-year and files no net-expenses fact, or whose flows are all scaled the same way, satisfies the identity while every figure is wrong. fourth_quarter_income needs three filed quarters, so it stays silent for a first fiscal year. The suggested_check (TII vs gross_investment_income, 5 pct) also depends on an optional tag. Action should be propose_detector: flag any fund whose first 10-K income period runs under 12 months (duration_months < 12, or the 'Operations commenced' date inside the fiscal year) and that has no first_income_year_ends key. Expected false positives are near zero. The cause is shared (quarter_income_sql), so it should go to the cohort; the report's not_done says no other fund was checked.

Dry run (scratch/fund_runs/0001901612/review/strip_dryrun.py) of HEAD vs working issuer_name_strip_re over all 2,271 distinct raw investment_identifier values in g4zc bdc_holdings.csv: exactly one changes, 'Entomo Brands Acquisitions, Inc, Senior secured1' (2 rows, 2023-12-31 and 2024-03-31). It is also the only value with a digit glued to an instrument word, and the only g4xc published issuer_name the new pattern would still change. The agent counted 2,128; the conclusion is the same. issuer_name_printed did fire on it, so existing_detector is right. Note: the instrument error that came with this fix (see RVQ_BLK_449966ec3faf) is not caught by any rule.

request_reviews.rationale: verification_bug is the right class. X02 flags rows whose page prints no rate or spread (footnote 6: unfunded, no interest earned); under the 2026-11-04 ruling a misfiring check clears only by repair, not by disposition. The repair as specified in DC-0001901612-528713db6c keys on the printed line ('N/A' in the rate and spread columns plus a dash for par), not on a published null or par = 0. That is required: a par-only skip would also hide a funded loan whose par extraction failed. The three must-fail tests are the right shapes; add a fourth where the page prints 'N/A(6)' but a rate is published. Two such rows exist at 2026-03-31: the filer tagged footnote 6 as InvestmentInterestRate 6 on c-487 and c-597 (see unflagged_errors). Today the ledger closes the fund's X02 2026-03-31 through legacy dispositions, so this repair is cohort hygiene, not a sign-off blocker for this fund; it still needs measuring on every accepted sandbox.
